thig3.5:1.1:
[Ubbiri recalls the Buddha’s words:]
“‘Jīva, my daughter,’
you cry in the woods.
thig3.5:1.5: have been burned in that charnel ground.
thig3.5:1.6: For which of them do you grieve?”
thig3.5:2.2:
the arrow so hard to see,
embedded in my heart,
thig3.5:2.3:
he expelled from me
—overcome with grief—
the grief
thig3.5:3.3:
to the Buddha, Dhamma, & Saṅgha I go,
for refuge to
the Sage.
